title: Tamil Nadu deemed universities recorded separate 2026 entrance, merit and scholarship deadlines
description: Compare 2026 admission and scholarship timelines across Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, Karunya, VIT, SRM and Kalasalingam in Tamil Nadu.
summary: Unlike TNAU-affiliated colleges, Tamil Nadu’s deemed-to-be universities published independent 2026 agriculture admission calendars, including Amrita’s May 2026 AEEL examination dates and Karunya’s 29 May 2026 scholarship deadline.

sections.heading: Sourced 2026 dates across Tamil Nadu deemed universities
paragraphs: In Tamil Nadu, deemed-to-be universities conduct their own admissions outside the TNAU single-window system. [Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham](/university/amrita-vishwa-vidyapeetham) scheduled its tentative AEEL 2026 entrance examination on 9 and 10 May 2026 and later recorded a Phase 2 Ph.D. Agronomy application deadline on 30 September 2026. Meanwhile, [Karunya Institute of Technology and Sciences](/university/karunya-institute-of-technology-and-sciences) published a 29 May 2026 deadline for its Founder’s Scholarship applications.

[Vellore Institute of Technology](/university/vellore-institute-of-technology) operated its dedicated 2026 B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture merit-admission portal without an entrance exam, while [SRM Institute of Science and Technology](/university/srm-institute-of-science-and-technology) and [Kalasalingam Academy of Research and Education](/university/kalasalingam-academy-of-research-and-education) published their own institution-specific entry and fee schedules.

sections.heading: How to compare deemed-university offers with state colleges
paragraphs: When comparing these five deemed universities, check the exact ICAR-accredited academic unit in [how to check ICAR accreditation](/articles/icar-accreditation-how-to-check) and verify whether a scholarship deadline (such as Karunya’s 29 May date) closes earlier than general admission counselling. Read [agriculture scholarship conditions](/blogs/agriculture-scholarship-conditions) before subtracting any waiver from your budget.

faqs.question: Do VIT, SRM, Amrita, Karunya and Kalasalingam admit students through TNAU counselling?
faqs.answer: No. They are deemed-to-be universities with independent admission portals, eligibility rules and fee structures.

faqs.question: Does missing a scholarship deadline mean general admissions are closed?
faqs.answer: Not necessarily. Karunya’s 29 May 2026 date was specific to its Founder’s Scholarship scope; check the main admission office for seat availability.
